COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
CRLA No. 49 of 2024
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Kailash Chandra, learned counsel for the 
appellant.
2. Mr. J.S. Virk, Deputy Advocate General for 
the State.
3. This is an appeal under Section 374(2) of 
Cr.P.C. against the judgment and order dated 
12.12.2023 passed by the Special Session Judge, 
POCSO, Haldwani, Nainital in Special Sessions 
Trial No. 38 of 2021, State Vs. Girish Chandra, 
whereby, the appellant was convicted under 
Sections 363, 366, 376(3) IPC and under Section 5 
(J)(ii)/6 of POCSO Act and has been sentenced as 
hereunder;-
(i) Under Section 5 (J)(ii)/6 of POCSO, twenty years 
rigorous imprisonment and a fine of Rs. 10,000 with 
default stipulation of six months additional
imprisonment. 
(ii) Under Section 363 IPC, five years rigorous 
imprisonment and a fine of Rs. 5000/- with default 
stipulation of three months additional imprisonment.
(iii) Under Section 366 IPC, five years rigorous 
imprisonment and a fine of Rs. 5000/- with default 
stipulation of three months additional imprisonment.
All the sentences were directed to run concurrently 
except the sentence of payment of fine and the period 
spent under custody by the appellant shall be set-off in 
accordance with section 428 of Cr.P.C. 4. As per the office report, the appeal is within 
time.
5. Admit.
6. Summon the Lower Court Record.
7. List this matter on 12.03.2024.
8. In the meantime, State may file objection to 
the bail application.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
Vacation Judge
 06.02.2024
Ujjwal
